mapper.select: SELECT stock_code FROM stock_master
SELECT id, collect_interval, ai_strategy_mode, collect_on_weekend, collect_on_holiday FROM collector_config WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE collector_config SET collect_interval = #{interval} WHERE id = 1
UPDATE collector_config SET ai_strategy_mode = #{mode} WHERE id = 1
UPDATE collector_config SET collect_on_weekend = #{weekend}, collect_on_holiday = #{holiday} WHERE id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT index_name, index_value, change_val, change_rate FROM market_index_history WHERE id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM market_index_history GROUP BY index_name)

SELECT i.*, COALESCE((SELECT signal_type FROM ai_prediction WHERE target_name = i.industry_name ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 'WAIT') as ai_signal, COALESCE((SELECT prediction_score FROM ai_prediction WHERE target_name = i.industry_name ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 50) as ai_score, COALESCE( (SELECT prediction_score FROM ai_prediction WHERE target_name = i.industry_name ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT prediction_score FROM ai_prediction WHERE target_name = i.industry_name AND created_at < CURDATE() ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 0 ) as score_diff FROM industry_quotes i ORDER BY i.change_rate DESC

SELECT theme_name, COALESCE(SUM(avg_change_rate), 0) as total_score, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lead_stocks SEPARATOR ', ') as lead_stocks FROM market_themes WHERE updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) GROUP BY theme_name ORDER BY total_score DESC

SELECT sm.stock_name, sd.foreign_net_buy, sd.top_brokers FROM stock_supply_demand sd JOIN stock_master sm ON sd.stock_code = sm.stock_code WHERE sd.captured_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ORDER BY sd.foreign_net_buy DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ap.*, sm.stock_name FROM ai_prediction ap JOIN stock_master sm ON ap.target_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CONCAT('STOCK_', sm.stock_code) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE ap.id >= (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) - 3000 FROM ai_prediction) AND ap.signal_type NOT IN ('WAIT', 'NORMAL') ORDER BY ap.id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN change_rate > 0 THEN 1 END) as rising_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN change_rate < 0 THEN 1 END) as falling_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN change_rate = 0 THEN 1 END) as steady_count FROM industry_quotes
SELECT * FROM stock_supply_demand WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

(SELECT 'AMOUNT' as type, stock_name, stock_code FROM stock_rankings WHERE ranking_type = 'AMOUNT' AND captured_at = (SELECT MAX(captured_at) FROM stock_rankings WHERE ranking_type = 'AMOUNT') ORDER BY rank_val ASC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL (SELECT 'RISE' as type, stock_name, stock_code FROM stock_rankings WHERE ranking_type = 'RISE' AND captured_at = (SELECT MAX(captured_at) FROM stock_rankings WHERE ranking_type = 'RISE') ORDER BY rank_val ASC LIMIT 3)

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN i.change_rate > 0 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 1), 0) as hit_rate FROM ai_prediction ap JOIN industry_quotes i ON ap.target_name = i.industry_name WHERE ap.id >= (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) - 100000 FROM ai_prediction) AND ap.signal_type = 'BUY' AND ap.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
SELECT lead_stocks FROM industry_quotes WHERE industry_name = #{industryName} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.stock_name as name, m.stock_code as code, 0.0 as x, COALESCE((SELECT prediction_score FROM ai_prediction WHERE target_name = CONCAT('STOCK_', m.stock_code) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 50) as y, COALESCE((SELECT volume FROM stock_supply_demand WHERE stock_code = m.stock_code ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 0) as volume, COALESCE((SELECT foreign_net_buy * current_price FROM stock_supply_demand WHERE stock_code = m.stock_code ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 0) as z, COALESCE((SELECT signal_type FROM ai_prediction WHERE target_name = CONCAT('STOCK_', m.stock_code) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 'WAIT') as ai_signal FROM stock_master m WHERE
m.stock_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{item}, '%')
ORDER BY m.market_cap DESC
SELECT * FROM ai_next_leaders WHERE DATE(captured_at) = #{date} ORDER BY total_score DESC, captured_at DESC, stock_code ASC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_next_leaders SET feedback_tag = #{feedbackTag} WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND DATE(captured_at) = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_financials (stock_code, report_year, report_code, revenue, op_profit, net_income, roe, created_at) VALUES (#{stock_code}, #{report_year}, #{report_code}, #{revenue}, #{op_profit}, #{net_income}, #{roe}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE revenue = #{revenue}, op_profit = #{op_profit}, net_income = #{net_income}, roe = #{roe}, created_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT 'LSTM' as model_name, COALESCE(ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN lstm_score >= 50 AND hit_result = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN lstm_score >= 50 AND hit_result != 'PENDING' THEN 1 END), 0) * 100, 1), 0) as hit_rate, (SELECT ROUND(weight_lstm * 100) FROM collector_config WHERE id = 1) as weight, (SELECT tuning_reason FROM collector_config WHERE id = 1) as tuning_reason FROM ai_next_leaders UNION ALL SELECT 'TCN' as model_name, COALESCE(ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN tcn_score >= 50 AND hit_result = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN tcn_score >= 50 AND hit_result != 'PENDING' THEN 1 END), 0) * 100, 1), 0) as hit_rate, (SELECT ROUND(weight_tcn * 100) FROM collector_config WHERE id = 1) as weight, (SELECT tuning_reason FROM collector_config WHERE id = 1) as tuning_reason FROM ai_next_leaders UNION ALL SELECT 'XGB' as model_name, COALESCE(ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN xgb_score >= 50 AND hit_result = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN xgb_score >= 50 AND hit_result != 'PENDING' THEN 1 END), 0) * 100, 1), 0) as hit_rate, (SELECT ROUND(weight_xgb * 100) FROM collector_config WHERE id = 1) as weight, (SELECT tuning_reason FROM collector_config WHERE id = 1) as tuning_reason FROM ai_next_leaders

SELECT stock_code, stock_name, total_score, price_at_recom, price_after_3d, hit_result, DATE_FORMAT(captured_at, '%m.%d') as date FROM ai_next_leaders WHERE hit_result != 'PENDING' AND is_top10 = 'Y' ORDER BY captured_at DESC, total_score DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM market_holidays WHERE holiday_year = #{year} ORDER BY holiday_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_holidays (holiday_date, holiday_name, holiday_year) VALUES (#{holiday_date}, #{holiday_name}, #{holiday_year})
mapper.update: UPDATE market_holidays SET holiday_date = #{holiday_date}, holiday_name = #{holiday_name}, holiday_year = #{holiday_year} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_holidays WHERE holiday_date = #{date}

SELECT t1.stock_code, t1.stock_name, t1.smart_money_score as max_score, t1.captured_at as last_detected, t1.reason, t1.price_at_recom FROM ai_next_leaders t1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT stock_code, MAX(id) as max_id FROM ai_next_leaders WHERE smart_money_score >= 90 AND captured_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY stock_code ) t2 ON t1.id = t2.max_id ORDER BY t1.captured_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_evaluated, COUNT(CASE WHEN hit_result = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as success_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN hit_result = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) as overall_hit_rate, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN hit_result != 'PENDING' AND price_at_recom > 0 THEN (price_after_3d - price_at_recom) / price_at_recom * 100 END), 2) as avg_return_rate, COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN hit_result = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) FROM ai_next_leaders WHERE hit_result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') AND captured_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ), 0.0) as recent_30d_hit_rate, COALESCE(( SELECT stock_name FROM ai_next_leaders WHERE hit_result = 'SUCCESS' AND captured_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY (price_after_3d - price_at_recom) / price_at_recom DESC LIMIT 1 ), '-') as best_pick_name, COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(MAX((price_after_3d - price_at_recom) / price_at_recom * 100), 1) FROM ai_next_leaders WHERE hit_result = 'SUCCESS' AND captured_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ), 0.0) as best_pick_return FROM ai_next_leaders WHERE hit_result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL')

SELECT h.stock_code, m.stock_name, h.price, h.volume, ROUND(h.rsi, 1) as rsi, h.program_net_buy, h.obv, ( (CASE WHEN h.rsi <= 40 THEN 30 WHEN h.rsi <= 55 THEN 20 ELSE 10 END) + (CASE WHEN h.program_net_buy > 0 THEN LEAST(40, ROUND(h.program_net_buy / 10000)) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN h.obv > 0 THEN 20 ELSE 5 END) ) as live_score, DATE_FORMAT(h.captured_at, '%H:%i') as captured_time FROM ( SELECT * FROM stock_intraday_history WHERE captured_at >= (SELECT MAX(captured_at) FROM stock_intraday_history) - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE ) h JOIN stock_master m ON h.stock_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = m.stock_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GROUP BY h.stock_code, m.stock_name, h.price, h.volume, h.rsi, h.program_net_buy, h.obv, h.captured_at ORDER BY live_score DESC, h.program_net_buy DESC LIMIT 10
